content: Release installers don't include the server. release.yml packages only the Flutter client (Windows Inno installer, macOS DMG, Linux .deb/AppImage). It never mentions the Node server, yet the README promises "one app" and the client defaults to http://localhost:3011/api. The Linux-only installer-stub.sh bundles Node and the server but the workflow doesn't reference it.	CONFIRMED (workflow). LIKELY a downloaded installer can't run standalone; I didn't check whether the app spawns the server itself.
